newsitem.title: UK: BG eases again on Ofgas price cap proposals.
newsitem.headline: BG eases again on Ofgas price cap proposals.

text.p: Shares in BG Plc extended losses on Wednesday, as the market showed a delayed reaction to industry regulator Ofgas' price capping proposals, published on Tuesday, dealers and analysts said.
BG shares fell 3p to 247p by 0856 GMT in volume of 3.6 million shares.
"The price proposals were hidden away in the fine print but the news was all over the press today so the market's showing a stronger reaction than it did yesterday," said one analyst.
Ofgas said its proposals formed the basis of amended licence conditions "which give effect to the MMC (Monopolies and Mergers Commission) recommendations" published on June 18.

However, BG disputed this and said it was concerned Ofgas would impose a different procedure from the formula recommended by the MMC in which 50 percent of Transco's revenues varied according to the volume of gas it carried.
Ofgas said it wanted to set in advance the volumes to be included in the price control calculations, which would in effect set a revenue cap on Transco.
BG said this could lead to greater gas price volatility.
"We are very disappointed to see this departure from the MMC report," BG said, "and we will be using the 28 day consultation period to try and persuade Ofgas to think again."
